question: What logical problem arises if one tries to purify an allegedly impure mass of beings?
premises: If the mass of beings is taken as impure, some means of purification must be proposed.
Any proposed purifier would itself require justification or purification.
This leads to infinite regress and futile mutual dependence.
inference: Attempting to purify an allegedly impure world produces infinite regress and futile mutual dependence.
plain_english: And even if the mass of beings were impure, by what means could purification be effected? In that way there would be infinite regress and likewise a futile mutual dependence.
